The environment does not support the dotall flag, so I will use a plain multiline string and anchor each title with its first occurrence.

```python
content = movie_recommendations_note['content']
titles = []
anchor_positions = [content.index(anchor) for anchor in ['# Movie Recommendations', '- director'] if anchor in content]
for anchor, next_anchor in zip(anchor_positions, anchor_positions[1:] + [len(content)]):
    title = content[anchor + len(anchor):next_anchor].strip()
    if title and title not in titles:
        titles.append(title)
reply_text = ','.join(titles)
print(reply_text)
```
